description: The line plot, titled “Hidden State Mean,” illustrates the evolution of the absolute mean of hidden states across 20 model layers for three distinct conditions: “hidden state mean before gate” (blue dashed line), “hidden state mean after gate” (orange dotted line), and “hidden state mean of baseline” (green solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 20 with integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4 with tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate, starts near 0.1 at Layer 0, rises gradually to approximately 1.5 by Layer 10, then steeply increases to 4.0 by Layer 20. The orange dotted line, representing the hidden state mean after the gate, begins near 0.05 at Layer 0, remains nearly flat and close to the green line until Layer 15, then rises slightly to about 1.8 by Layer 20. The green solid line, representing the baseline, starts near 0.04 at Layer 0 and increases linearly to approximately 2.0 by Layer 20. The legend indicates average values over all layers: 0.71 for before gate, 0.05 for after gate, and 0.04 for baseline.
